_: REFUND POLICY. Rewritten 2026-08-02 on Cole's instruction: policy pages are policy. Plain, organised, scannable. No review anecdotes, no charm lines, no rhetorical framing, no asides. The reader wants to know what the rule is and what to do.
_structure: Follows the store's own published Refund policy section for section, so the two cannot drift: how to start a return, general rules, clubs 60 days, apparel 30 days, gear 30 days, customised, defective, non-returnable. It is NOT a clubs page with apparel bolted on — every category gets its own section at the same level.
_sourced: Product Reference Guide v1.8 Return policy + the live Shopify Refund policy, which agree. DEFECTIVE ITEMS: Cole confirmed 2026-08-02 that Lucky pays return shipping when the item is defective. That was the last open question on this page.
headline: Returns and refunds
lede: Return windows, conditions and refund handling for every Lucky Golf product. Read the section for what you bought.

paras: Use the Returns Portal, or follow the instructions in your order confirmation email.
No prior approval is needed. The item must meet the conditions below to be refunded.
All club returns require approval before the club is sent back. Contact Customer Support through the website chat or at support@luckygolf.com.
Approval requires photo verification. A club returned without authorisation is not accepted.

tbd.label: Needs confirming
tbd.text: the Returns Portal's web address, so this section can link to it directly.

items: Returns must be started within the return window for that product category.
Refunds are issued only after the returned item is received and inspected.
Customers are responsible for return shipping costs, except on defective items.
Original shipping fees are non-refundable.
Items returned outside the stated conditions may receive a partial refund, or be denied.
Customised items are final sale unless deemed defective.

sections.title: Golf clubs — 60 days
sections.lede: Returns must be started within 60 days of delivery. All club returns require approval before return, require photo verification prior to approval, and are refunded only after physical inspection.

paras: May be used during the 60-day period.
Must be returned in brand-new condition, with no face marks, sole wear, scratches, dents, chips, bag chatter or grip wear.
Modifications — regripping, bending, cutting or altering — are not permitted.
Wear or damage may result in a partial refund or return denial.
Only one wedge per set may be opened and tested, on a turf mat or other non-abrasive surface.
The tested wedge must be returned in brand-new condition, with no groove wear, face marks, sole wear, or cosmetic or structural damage.
All other wedges in the set must remain factory sealed.
Significant use or damage may result in a partial refund or return denial.
Must appear completely unused, with no visible signs of wear or damage and no modifications.
Significant use or damage may result in a partial refund or no refund, depending on condition.

sections.title: Apparel — 30 days
sections.lede: Returns must be started within 30 days of delivery.

items: Unworn, unwashed and in original condition.
All original tags attached.
No makeup or deodorant stains, odours, pet hair, stretching or laundering.
Items returned without tags have a $7 fee deducted from the refund.
Requests after 30 days are not accepted.

sections.title: Gear and accessories — 30 days
sections.lede: Returns must be started within 30 days of delivery.

items: Must be returned in unused condition.
Items showing wear, damage or use are not eligible.
A grip that has been fitted to a shaft counts as used.
Defective items may be eligible for replacement or refund upon inspection.

sections.title: Defective items
sections.lede: If an item is defective, we pay the return shipping.
paras: Contact us before sending anything back. Email support@luckygolf.com or use the website chat, with your order number and photos of the fault.
Defective items may be replaced or refunded after inspection.
Customised items, which are otherwise final sale, are returnable if they arrive defective.

items: All customised products are final sale.
Not eligible for return or refund unless deemed defective upon inspection.
The item shows visible wear or damage beyond the stated conditions.
The item has been modified.
The return window has passed.
Required approval or documentation is not provided.
The item is returned without authorisation.

close.headline: Ask before you send
close.body: If you are not sure whether something qualifies, ask first. Club returns need approval either way.
